sin.name: countdown-outside-block-until
sin.description: A rule counts tool uses itself to work out how long an agent has left before it is held, so the count, its line and its block are its own.
sin.rule: Hold an agent after a grace with OpenHold(agent, NUDGE, condition, Interval(ToolUseWindow(n)), COUNTDOWN.agent_message("{left}")): agent_block_rule counts the tool uses, says the countdown and holds the agent. The new driver's StoredAgentViewReader counts an open row's grace uses the same way for the agent machine.
